etag.description: The saved record's ETag, for If-Match; absent when the item was refused or previewed.

id.description: The saved record's ID; absent when the item was refused or previewed.

index.description: The item's position in the request, from 0.

problem.description: Why the item was refused (RFC 9457), with its stable code; absent when it was saved or previewed.

status.description: What the item's own request would have answered: 201 saved, 200 previewed (nothing saved), or the status of its problem.
